title: Locate the nonlinear mapping responsible for behaviorally relevant reaching dynamics
scientific_question: Where must nonlinear mappings be placed to explain behaviorally relevant neural dynamics, as tested by the complete public grid-reaching Figure6h–i comparison?

paired_access_conditions.A: Paper and sufficient scientific specification plus identical complete authorized data and train/dev labels; no official implementation.
paired_access_conditions.B: The same paper/specification/data and role information plus pinned official code. Missing essential method specification is a construction defect, not an A-arm model failure.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Equal execution, tuning and compute budgets; same complete held cases and metric. Public event schedules and paper-provided information remain equally available. Code/model/checkpoint exposure and contamination are audited.
paired_access_conditions.outcomes: Separate historical reproduction from prospective improvement. Preserve original test-selection/leakage if reproducing it, label it, and never substitute a corrected split without a distinct prospective result. Narrative cannot replace numeric artifacts.

paper.title: Dissociative and prioritized modeling of behaviorally relevant neural dynamics using recurrent neural networks

data.version: Exact record 3854034; 47 MAT sessions plus refh_results.csv
data.representation: Original spike timestamps and kinematics; exclude published result CSV from agent inputs.
data.blocker: Map the paper's seven sessions to complete release; no arbitrary seven chosen from 47.

official_code.license: USC educational/research/nonprofit permission; commercial permission separate.
official_code.availability: Official repository/current commit and license verified.

complete_scope: Complete public grid-reaching Figure 6h–i assay, all seven paper-defined sessions and all model nonlinear-placement alternatives, state dimensions and folds. This is explicitly a bounded central subclaim, not reproduction of all five datasets or the two request-only cohorts.

outputs: Neural CC versus behavior CC frontier for all declared nonlinear placements
Original training-selected latent dimensions and full session/fold outcomes
baselines: Only A-prime, K, Cy or Cz nonlinear variants

prospective_improvement.endpoint: Better held-session behavior CC at a prespecified noninferiority margin on neural self-prediction, with training-only dimension/architecture selection. Test stability of the inferred nonlinear locus across sessions.
prospective_improvement.heldout_unit: Complete temporal blocks for original folds, plus whole recording session for generalization; session/animal grouped intervals.
controls: No behavior target passed during held neural inference
Symmetric smoothing leakage audit; prospective causal profile distinct from original Gaussian smoothing

resources.basis: Complete seven-session/fivefold nonlinear-placement and latent-dimension grid, including tuning; 24 GB complete release gives acquisition upper bound. No measured cost.

overlap: Same Sabes/O'Doherty family as NEURAL-023/024 and DFINE/POYO. Endpoint is nonlinear-placement identification and joint neural-behavior frontier, distinct from continuous decoding or cross-day stability.
participant_inputs: Original neural spike timestamps and kinematics for all seven paper-selected grid-reaching sessions, all35 session-folds, full dimensions and nonlinear placements; do not choose seven convenient sessions from47 or expose published resultCSV.

machine_output.predictions: All held neural and behavior predictions for each original session/fold/dimension/nonlinear-placement method.
machine_output.tables: Complete neuralCC–behaviorCC frontier and only-A-prime/K/Cy/Cz versus fully linear/nonlinear contrasts, dimension selection records and session/animal results.
machine_output.artifacts: Frozen models/configurations, exact published smoothing and separately labelled causal profile, train/dev provenance.

scoring: Recompute neural self-prediction and behavior correlations under exact original aggregation; prospective held-session behaviorCC improvement at fixed neuralCC noninferiority and matched capacity. Exact margin remains a preregistration gate.
protected_split: Full original temporal blocks with appropriate context purge; session-held prospective assessment. TRAIN/DEV chooses dimension/architecture; no held behavior or symmetric-filter future leakage in causal inference.
comparators: All declared nonlinear-locus variants, fully linear and fully nonlinear model, matched parameter/dimension controls and permitted time/kinematic priors.
distinctness: Tests the scientific localization of needed nonlinearity, not merely reaching-decoder accuracy or day-drift robustness; distinct from NEURAL023/024 and DFINE missingness.

publication_context.historical_administrative_text: Proposal-era counts, recommendations and source-phase observations in inherited fields are historical. The package registry records the applied 233-draft programme state; no authentic readiness is inferred.
publication_context.private_locator_policy: Null path fields identify private construction evidence that is not shipped or dereferenced. Original byte/hash pins are provenance references, not public validation certificates or dependency availability.
